engine: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 + daily root-zone water balance (single Kc) + FAO-33 yield response to water (Ky by phase), ensemble over NASA POWER years
warnings: Yield is an estimate from a simplified physical model (water limitation only); it does not account for pests, diseases, nutrition, frost, waterlogging or the direct effect of heat.
NASA POWER resolution is ~0.5° (tens of km): weather represents the region, not the field.
Δrain/ΔT scenarios are sensitivity tests, not climate projections.
Default reference yield (4000 kg/ha) is a placeholder; calibrate with municipal IBGE/PAM data.
No price/cost provided: economic results omitted.
assumptions: Phase durations fitted to a 120-day cycle (medium-cycle cultivar); adjust per cultivar.
Late-phase Ky (0.2) is an assumption; FAO-33 does not tabulate soybean maturation.
Reference yield of 4000 kg/ha is a placeholder; calibrate with IBGE/PAM.
35 °C heat threshold at flowering is an indicator; it does not enter the yield calculation.
Soil 'Clayey (e.g., Latosol/Oxisol)': FC 0.36, WP 0.22 m³/m³, CN 82 (FAO-56 table 19, central values).
Roots grow linearly until the start of the mid-season phase; newly explored soil starts at field capacity.

indicator_methods.blue_water_m3_ha: Applied irrigation (mm, gross) × 10 — water withdrawn from rivers/wells.
indicator_methods.green_water_m3_ha: max(0, ETa − net irrigation) × 10 — rainwater used by the crop.
indicator_methods.deep_percolation_mm: Drainage below the root zone — PROXY for nutrient-leaching risk.
indicator_methods.runoff_mm: SCS-CN runoff — PROXY for erosion and soil-loss risk.
indicator_methods.water_stress_days: Days with Ks < 1 (water below the readily available fraction).
indicator_methods.heat_stress_days_flowering: Days with Tmax above the crop threshold during flowering.
indicator_methods.soil_cover_days: Days with canopy cover ≥ 30% — PROXY for soil protection.
